111  /**
112   * Returns the key under which the backup code tracks a region server. The key is the server's
113   * host:port with the hostname lowercased. WAL file names contain the lowercased hostname (see
114   * {@link ServerName#toString()}), while {@link ServerName#getAddress()} keeps the hostname's
115   * original case, so both spellings must map to the same key.
116   * @param hostAndPort host:port of a region server, in any case
117   * @return the lowercased host:port
118   */
119  public static String toHostKey(String hostAndPort) {
120    return hostAndPort.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
121  }

123  /**
124   * Loop through the RS log timestamp map for the tables, for each RS, find the min timestamp value
125   * for the RS among the tables.
126   * @param rsLogTimestampMap timestamp map
127   * @return the min timestamp of each RS
128   */
129  public static Map<String, Long>
130    getRSLogTimestampMins(Map<TableName, Map<String, Long>> rsLogTimestampMap) {
131    return rsLogTimestampMap.values().stream().flatMap(map -> map.entrySet().stream())
132      .collect(Collectors.toMap(Entry::getKey, Entry::getValue, Math::min));
133  }

135  /**
136   * copy out Table RegionInfo into incremental backup image need to consider move this logic into
137   * HBackupFileSystem
138   * @param conn       connection
139   * @param backupInfo backup info
140   * @param conf       configuration
141   * @throws IOException exception
142   */
143  public static void copyTableRegionInfo(Connection conn, BackupInfo backupInfo, Configuration conf)
144    throws IOException {
145    Path rootDir = CommonFSUtils.getRootDir(conf);
146    FileSystem fs = rootDir.getFileSystem(conf);
147
148    // for each table in the table set, copy out the table info and region
149    // info files in the correct directory structure
150    try (Admin admin = conn.getAdmin()) {
151      for (TableName table : backupInfo.getTables()) {
152        if (!admin.tableExists(table)) {
153          LOG.warn("Table " + table + " does not exists, skipping it.");
154          continue;
155        }
156        TableDescriptor orig = FSTableDescriptors.getTableDescriptorFromFs(fs, rootDir, table);
157
158        // write a copy of descriptor to the target directory
159        Path target = new Path(backupInfo.getTableBackupDir(table));
160        FileSystem targetFs = target.getFileSystem(conf);
161        try (FSTableDescriptors descriptors =
162          new FSTableDescriptors(targetFs, CommonFSUtils.getRootDir(conf))) {
163          descriptors.createTableDescriptorForTableDirectory(target, orig, false);
164        }
165        LOG.debug("Attempting to copy table info for:" + table + " target: " + target
166          + " descriptor: " + orig);
167        LOG.debug("Finished copying tableinfo.");
168        List<RegionInfo> regions = MetaTableAccessor.getTableRegions(conn, table);
169        // For each region, write the region info to disk
170        LOG.debug("Starting to write region info for table " + table);
171        for (RegionInfo regionInfo : regions) {
172          Path regionDir = FSUtils
173            .getRegionDirFromTableDir(new Path(backupInfo.getTableBackupDir(table)), regionInfo);
174          regionDir = new Path(backupInfo.getTableBackupDir(table), regionDir.getName());
175          writeRegioninfoOnFilesystem(conf, targetFs, regionDir, regionInfo);
176        }
177        LOG.debug("Finished writing region info for table " + table);
178      }
179    }
180  }
181
182  /**
183   * Write the .regioninfo file on-disk.
184   */
185  public static void writeRegioninfoOnFilesystem(final Configuration conf, final FileSystem fs,
186    final Path regionInfoDir, RegionInfo regionInfo) throws IOException {
187    final byte[] content = RegionInfo.toDelimitedByteArray(regionInfo);
188    Path regionInfoFile = new Path(regionInfoDir, "." + HConstants.REGIONINFO_QUALIFIER_STR);
189    // First check to get the permissions
190    FsPermission perms = CommonFSUtils.getFilePermissions(fs, conf, HConstants.DATA_FILE_UMASK_KEY);
191    // Write the RegionInfo file content
192    FSDataOutputStream out = FSUtils.create(conf, fs, regionInfoFile, perms, null);
193    try {
194      out.write(content);
195    } finally {
196      out.close();
197    }
198  }

200  /**
201   * Parses hostname:port from WAL file path
202   * @param p path to WAL file
203   * @return hostname:port
204   */
205  public static String parseHostNameFromLogFile(Path p) {
206    try {
207      if (AbstractFSWALProvider.isArchivedLogFile(p)) {
208        return BackupUtils.parseHostFromOldLog(p);
209      } else {
210        ServerName sname = AbstractFSWALProvider.getServerNameFromWALDirectoryName(p);
211        if (sname != null) {
212          return toHostKey(sname.getAddress().toString());
213        } else {
214          LOG.error("Skip log file (can't parse): " + p);
215          return null;
216        }
217      }
218    } catch (Exception e) {
219      LOG.error("Skip log file (can't parse): " + p, e);
220      return null;
221    }
222  }

224  /**
225   * Returns the log roll result of every region server that took part in the log roll that happened
226   * between reading {@code previousLogRolls} and {@code latestLogRolls}. A region server that did
227   * not take part (for example because it is offline) keeps its old roll result, which is never
228   * removed, so it is recognized by its roll result not changing.
229   * @param previousLogRolls roll results by host, read before the log roll
230   * @param latestLogRolls   roll results by host, read after the log roll
231   * @return roll results by host, for the hosts that took part in the log roll
232   */
233  public static Map<String, Long> getRolledHosts(Map<String, Long> previousLogRolls,
234    Map<String, Long> latestLogRolls) {
235    return latestLogRolls.entrySet().stream()
236      .filter(entry -> !entry.getValue().equals(previousLogRolls.get(entry.getKey())))
237      .collect(Collectors.toMap(Entry::getKey, Entry::getValue));
238  }

240  /**
241   * Computes the per-host log boundaries stored by a backup that has no previous boundaries to
242   * carry forward, such as a full backup. See
243   * {@link #computeLogBoundaries(Map, Map, Set, Collection, Collection)}.
244   */
245  public static Map<String, Long> computeLogBoundaries(Map<String, Long> rolledHosts,
246    Collection<String> coveredLogs, Collection<String> pendingLogs) throws IOException {
247    return computeLogBoundaries(rolledHosts, Collections.emptyMap(), Collections.emptySet(),
248      coveredLogs, pendingLogs);
249  }
250
251  /**
252   * Computes the per-host log boundaries stored by a backup. Everything up to a host's boundary is
253   * covered by backups, so later incremental backups only include that host's logs that are newer.
254   * <ul>
255   * <li>A host that took part in the backup's log roll gets its roll result.</li>
256   * <li>Any other host gets the creation time of its newest covered log, capped to just below its
257   * oldest pending log, so that pending logs are included in a later backup.</li>
258   * <li>A host without covered or pending logs keeps its previous boundary while it still has logs,
259   * and otherwise gets no boundary.</li>
260   * </ul>
261   * Capping is needed because a host's logs can still be pending while some of its newer logs are
262   * already covered, for example when a dead server's logs are split and archived out of order. As
263   * a result, the next backup includes the covered logs that are newer than the cap a second time:
264   * losing the pending logs is worse than repeating edits that are already backed up. A host is
265   * also kept while any of its logs are pending, even if none are covered, because without a
266   * boundary the next backup would treat it as unknown and skip its older logs. For the same reason
267   * a host keeps its previous boundary while it still has logs: without it, the next backup would
268   * include its logs that are already covered, which can bring back deleted data.
269   * @param rolledHosts        roll results of the hosts that took part in the log roll
270   * @param previousBoundaries boundaries stored by the previous backup
271   * @param hostsWithLogs      hosts that still have logs, whether or not this backup includes them
272   * @param coveredLogs        logs whose edits are included in the backup
273   * @param pendingLogs        logs whose edits are not to be included in the backup
274   * @return boundaries by host
275   */
276  public static Map<String, Long> computeLogBoundaries(Map<String, Long> rolledHosts,
277    Map<String, Long> previousBoundaries, Set<String> hostsWithLogs, Collection<String> coveredLogs,
278    Collection<String> pendingLogs) throws IOException {
279    Map<String, Long> otherHosts = new HashMap<>();
280    for (String log : coveredLogs) {
281      Path path = new Path(log);
282      String host = parseHostNameFromLogFile(path);
283      if (host != null && !rolledHosts.containsKey(host)) {
284        otherHosts.merge(host, getCreationTime(path), Math::max);
285      }
286    }
287    for (String log : pendingLogs) {
288      Path path = new Path(log);
289      String host = parseHostNameFromLogFile(path);
290      if (host != null && !rolledHosts.containsKey(host)) {
291        otherHosts.merge(host, getCreationTime(path) - 1, Math::min);
292      }
293    }
294    Map<String, Long> boundaries = new HashMap<>(rolledHosts);
295    boundaries.putAll(otherHosts);
296    for (Entry<String, Long> previous : previousBoundaries.entrySet()) {
297      if (hostsWithLogs.contains(previous.getKey())) {
298        boundaries.putIfAbsent(previous.getKey(), previous.getValue());
299      }
300    }
301    return boundaries;
302  }

322  /**
323   * Get the total length of files under the given directory recursively.
324   * @param fs  The hadoop file system
325   * @param dir The target directory
326   * @return the total length of files
327   * @throws IOException exception
328   */
329  public static long getFilesLength(FileSystem fs, Path dir) throws IOException {
330    long totalLength = 0;
331    FileStatus[] files = CommonFSUtils.listStatus(fs, dir);
332    if (files != null) {
333      for (FileStatus fileStatus : files) {
334        if (fileStatus.isDirectory()) {
335          totalLength += getFilesLength(fs, fileStatus.getPath());
336        } else {
337          totalLength += fileStatus.getLen();
338        }
339      }
340    }
341    return totalLength;
342  }

344  /**
345   * Get list of all old WAL files (WALs and archive)
346   * @param c                configuration
347   * @param hostTimestampMap {host,timestamp} map
348   * @return list of WAL files
349   * @throws IOException exception
350   */
351  public static List<String> getWALFilesOlderThan(final Configuration c,
352    final HashMap<String, Long> hostTimestampMap) throws IOException {
353    Path walRootDir = CommonFSUtils.getWALRootDir(c);
354    Path logDir = new Path(walRootDir, HConstants.HREGION_LOGDIR_NAME);
355    Path oldLogDir = new Path(walRootDir, HConstants.HREGION_OLDLOGDIR_NAME);
356    List<String> logFiles = new ArrayList<>();
357
358    PathFilter filter = p -> {
359      try {
360        if (AbstractFSWALProvider.isMetaFile(p)) {
361          return false;
362        }
363        String host = parseHostNameFromLogFile(p);
364        if (host == null) {
365          return false;
366        }
367        Long oldTimestamp = hostTimestampMap.get(host);
368        Long currentLogTS = BackupUtils.getCreationTime(p);
369        return currentLogTS <= oldTimestamp;
370      } catch (Exception e) {
371        LOG.warn("Can not parse" + p, e);
372        return false;
373      }
374    };
375    FileSystem walFs = CommonFSUtils.getWALFileSystem(c);
376    logFiles = BackupUtils.getFiles(walFs, logDir, logFiles, filter);
377    logFiles = BackupUtils.getFiles(walFs, oldLogDir, logFiles, filter);
378    return logFiles;
379  }

381  public static TableName[] parseTableNames(String tables) {
382    if (tables == null) {

385    return Splitter.on(BackupRestoreConstants.TABLENAME_DELIMITER_IN_COMMAND).splitToStream(tables)

389  /**
390   * Check whether the backup path exist
391   * @param backupStr backup
392   * @param conf      configuration
393   * @return Yes if path exists
394   * @throws IOException exception
395   */
396  public static boolean checkPathExist(String backupStr, Configuration conf) throws IOException {
397    boolean isExist = false;
398    Path backupPath = new Path(backupStr);
399    FileSystem fileSys = backupPath.getFileSystem(conf);
400    String targetFsScheme = fileSys.getUri().getScheme();
401    if (LOG.isTraceEnabled()) {
402      LOG.trace("Schema of given url: " + backupStr + " is: " + targetFsScheme);
403    }
404    if (fileSys.exists(backupPath)) {
405      isExist = true;
406    }
407    return isExist;
408  }

410  /**
411   * Check target path first, confirm it doesn't exist before backup
412   * @param backupRootPath backup destination path
413   * @param conf           configuration
414   * @throws IOException exception
415   */
416  public static void checkTargetDir(String backupRootPath, Configuration conf) throws IOException {
417    boolean targetExists;
418    try {
419      targetExists = checkPathExist(backupRootPath, conf);
420    } catch (IOException e) {
421      String expMsg = e.getMessage();
422      String newMsg = null;
423      if (expMsg.contains("No FileSystem for scheme")) {
424        newMsg =
425          "Unsupported filesystem scheme found in the backup target url. Error Message: " + expMsg;
426        LOG.error(newMsg);
427        throw new IOException(newMsg);
428      } else {
429        throw e;
430      }
431    }
432
433    if (targetExists) {
434      LOG.info("Using existing backup root dir: " + backupRootPath);
435    } else {
436      LOG.info("Backup root dir " + backupRootPath + " does not exist. Will be created.");
437    }
438  }

440  /**
441   * Get the min value for all the Values a map.
442   * @param map map
443   * @return the min value
444   */
445  public static <T> Long getMinValue(Map<T, Long> map) {
446    Long minTimestamp = null;
447    if (map != null) {
448      ArrayList<Long> timestampList = new ArrayList<>(map.values());
449      Collections.sort(timestampList);
450      // The min among all the RS log timestamps will be kept in backup system table table.
451      minTimestamp = timestampList.get(0);
452    }
453    return minTimestamp;
454  }

456  /**
457   * Parses host name:port from archived WAL path
458   * @param p path
459   * @return host name
460   */
461  public static String parseHostFromOldLog(Path p) {
462    // Skip master wals
463    if (p.getName().endsWith(MasterRegionFactory.ARCHIVED_WAL_SUFFIX)) {
464      return null;
465    }
466    Path parent = p.getParent();
467    if (parent != null && ServerName.isFullServerName(parent.getName())) {
468      return toHostKey(ServerName.valueOf(parent.getName()).getAddress().toString());
469    }
470    try {
471      String urlDecodedName = URLDecoder.decode(p.getName(), "UTF8");
472      Iterable<String> nameSplitsOnComma = Splitter.on(",").split(urlDecodedName);
473      String host = Iterables.get(nameSplitsOnComma, 0);
474      String port = Iterables.get(nameSplitsOnComma, 1);
475      return toHostKey(host + ":" + port);
476    } catch (Exception e) {
477      LOG.warn("Skip log file (can't parse): {}", p);
478      return null;
479    }
480  }
481
482  /**
483   * Given the log file, parse the timestamp from the file name. The timestamp is the last number.
484   * @param p a path to the log file
485   * @return the timestamp
486   * @throws IOException exception
487   */
488  public static Long getCreationTime(Path p) throws IOException {
489    int idx = p.getName().lastIndexOf(LOGNAME_SEPARATOR);
490    if (idx < 0) {
491      throw new IOException("Cannot parse timestamp from path " + p);
492    }
493    String ts = p.getName().substring(idx + 1);
494    return Long.parseLong(ts);
495  }

497  public static List<String> getFiles(FileSystem fs, Path rootDir, List<String> files,
498    PathFilter filter) throws IOException {
499    RemoteIterator<LocatedFileStatus> it = fs.listFiles(rootDir, true);
500
501    while (it.hasNext()) {
502      LocatedFileStatus lfs = it.next();
503      if (lfs.isDirectory()) {
504        continue;
505      }
506      // apply filter
507      if (filter.accept(lfs.getPath())) {
508        files.add(lfs.getPath().toString());
509      }
510    }
511    return files;
512  }

514  public static void cleanupBackupData(BackupInfo context, Configuration conf) throws IOException {
515    cleanupHLogDir(context, conf);
516    cleanupTargetDir(context, conf);

519  /**
520   * Clean up directories which are generated when DistCp copying hlogs
521   * @param backupInfo backup info
522   * @param conf       configuration
523   * @throws IOException exception
524   */
525  private static void cleanupHLogDir(BackupInfo backupInfo, Configuration conf) throws IOException {
526    String logDir = backupInfo.getHLogTargetDir();
527    if (logDir == null) {
528      LOG.warn("No log directory specified for " + backupInfo.getBackupId());
529      return;
530    }
531
532    Path rootPath = new Path(logDir).getParent();
533    FileSystem fs = FileSystem.get(rootPath.toUri(), conf);
534    FileStatus[] files = listStatus(fs, rootPath, null);
535    if (files == null) {
536      return;
537    }
538    for (FileStatus file : files) {
539      LOG.debug("Delete log files: " + file.getPath().getName());
540      fs.delete(file.getPath(), true);
541    }
542  }
543
544  private static void cleanupTargetDir(BackupInfo backupInfo, Configuration conf) {
545    try {
546      // clean up the data at target directory
547      LOG.debug("Trying to cleanup up target dir : " + backupInfo.getBackupId());
548      String targetDir = backupInfo.getBackupRootDir();
549      if (targetDir == null) {
550        LOG.warn("No target directory specified for " + backupInfo.getBackupId());
551        return;
552      }
553
554      FileSystem outputFs = FileSystem.get(new Path(backupInfo.getBackupRootDir()).toUri(), conf);
555
556      for (TableName table : backupInfo.getTables()) {
557        Path targetDirPath = new Path(
558          getTableBackupDir(backupInfo.getBackupRootDir(), backupInfo.getBackupId(), table));
559        if (outputFs.delete(targetDirPath, true)) {
560          LOG.info("Cleaning up backup data at " + targetDirPath.toString() + " done.");
561        } else {
562          LOG.info("No data has been found in " + targetDirPath.toString() + ".");
563        }
564
565        Path tableDir = targetDirPath.getParent();
566        FileStatus[] backups = listStatus(outputFs, tableDir, null);
567        if (backups == null || backups.length == 0) {
568          outputFs.delete(tableDir, true);
569          LOG.debug(tableDir.toString() + " is empty, remove it.");
570        }
571      }
572      outputFs.delete(new Path(targetDir, backupInfo.getBackupId()), true);
573    } catch (IOException e1) {
574      LOG.error("Cleaning up backup data of " + backupInfo.getBackupId() + " at "
575        + backupInfo.getBackupRootDir() + " failed due to " + e1.getMessage() + ".");
576    }
577  }

579  /**
580   * Given the backup root dir, backup id and the table name, return the backup image location,
581   * which is also where the backup manifest file is. return value look like:
582   * "hdfs://backup.hbase.org:9000/user/biadmin/backup1/backup_1396650096738/default/t1_dn/"
583   * @param backupRootDir backup root directory
584   * @param backupId      backup id
585   * @param tableName     table name
586   * @return backupPath String for the particular table
587   */
588  public static String getTableBackupDir(String backupRootDir, String backupId,
589    TableName tableName) {
590    return backupRootDir + Path.SEPARATOR + backupId + Path.SEPARATOR
591      + tableName.getNamespaceAsString() + Path.SEPARATOR + tableName.getQualifierAsString()
592      + Path.SEPARATOR;
593  }

595  /**
596   * Calls fs.listStatus() and treats FileNotFoundException as non-fatal This accommodates
597   * differences between hadoop versions, where hadoop 1 does not throw a FileNotFoundException, and
598   * return an empty FileStatus[] while Hadoop 2 will throw FileNotFoundException.
599   * @param fs     file system
600   * @param dir    directory
601   * @param filter path filter
602   * @return null if dir is empty or doesn't exist, otherwise FileStatus array
603   */
604  public static FileStatus[] listStatus(final FileSystem fs, final Path dir,
605    final PathFilter filter) throws IOException {
606    FileStatus[] status = null;
607    try {
608      status = filter == null ? fs.listStatus(dir) : fs.listStatus(dir, filter);
609    } catch (FileNotFoundException fnfe) {
610      // if directory doesn't exist, return null
611      if (LOG.isTraceEnabled()) {
612        LOG.trace(dir + " doesn't exist");
613      }
614    }
615
616    if (status == null || status.length < 1) {
617      return null;
618    }
619
620    return status;
621  }

627   * <code>/hbase_trunk/TestTable/compaction.dir</code>. This method is useful if you want to print
628   * out a Path without qualifying Filesystem instance.

648  /**
649   * Loads all backup history as stored in files on the given backup root path.
650   * @return all backup history, from newest (most recent) to oldest (least recent)
651   */
652  private static List<BackupInfo> getHistory(Configuration conf, Path backupRootPath)
653    throws IOException {
654    // Get all (n) history from backup root destination
655
656    FileSystem fs = FileSystem.get(backupRootPath.toUri(), conf);
657    RemoteIterator<LocatedFileStatus> it;
658    try {
659      it = fs.listLocatedStatus(backupRootPath);
660    } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
661      return Collections.emptyList();
662    }
663
664    List<BackupInfo> infos = new ArrayList<>();
665    while (it.hasNext()) {
666      LocatedFileStatus lfs = it.next();
667
668      if (!lfs.isDirectory()) {
669        continue;
670      }
671
672      String backupId = lfs.getPath().getName();
673      try {
674        BackupInfo info = loadBackupInfo(backupRootPath, backupId, fs);
675        infos.add(info);
676      } catch (IOException e) {
677        LOG.error("Can not load backup info from: " + lfs.getPath(), e);
678      }
679    }
680    // Sort
681    infos.sort(Comparator.<BackupInfo> naturalOrder().reversed());
682    return infos;
683  }
684
685  /**
686   * Loads all backup history as stored in files on the given backup root path, and returns the
687   * first n entries matching all given filters.
688   * @return (subset of) backup history, from newest (most recent) to oldest (least recent)
689   */
690  public static List<BackupInfo> getHistory(Configuration conf, int n, Path backupRootPath,
691    BackupInfo.Filter... filters) throws IOException {
692    List<BackupInfo> infos = getHistory(conf, backupRootPath);
693
694    Predicate<BackupInfo> combinedPredicate = Stream.of(filters)
695      .map(filter -> (Predicate<BackupInfo>) filter).reduce(Predicate::and).orElse(x -> true);
696
697    return infos.stream().filter(combinedPredicate).limit(n).toList();
698  }
699
700  public static BackupInfo loadBackupInfo(Path backupRootPath, String backupId, FileSystem fs)
701    throws IOException {
702    Path backupPath = new Path(backupRootPath, backupId);
703
704    RemoteIterator<LocatedFileStatus> it = fs.listFiles(backupPath, true);
705    while (it.hasNext()) {
706      LocatedFileStatus lfs = it.next();
707      if (lfs.getPath().getName().equals(BackupManifest.MANIFEST_FILE_NAME)) {
708        // Load BackupManifest
709        BackupManifest manifest = new BackupManifest(fs, lfs.getPath().getParent());
710        BackupInfo info = manifest.toBackupInfo();
711        return info;
712      }
713    }
714    return null;
715  }

733  public static RestoreRequest createRestoreRequest(String backupRootDir, String backupId,
734    boolean check, TableName[] fromTables, TableName[] toTables, boolean isOverwrite,
735    boolean isKeepOriginalSplits) {
736    RestoreRequest.Builder builder = new RestoreRequest.Builder();
737    RestoreRequest request = builder.withBackupRootDir(backupRootDir).withBackupId(backupId)
738      .withCheck(check).withFromTables(fromTables).withToTables(toTables).withOverwrite(isOverwrite)
739      .withKeepOriginalSplits(isKeepOriginalSplits).build();
740    return request;
741  }

743  public static boolean validate(List<TableName> tables, BackupManifest backupManifest,
744    Configuration conf) throws IOException {
745    boolean isValid = true;
746
747    for (TableName table : tables) {
748      TreeSet<BackupImage> imageSet = new TreeSet<>();
749
750      ArrayList<BackupImage> depList = backupManifest.getDependentListByTable(table);
751      if (depList != null && !depList.isEmpty()) {
752        imageSet.addAll(depList);
753      }
754
755      LOG.info("Dependent image(s) from old to new:");
756      for (BackupImage image : imageSet) {
757        String imageDir =
758          HBackupFileSystem.getTableBackupDir(image.getRootDir(), image.getBackupId(), table);
759        if (!BackupUtils.checkPathExist(imageDir, conf)) {
760          LOG.error("ERROR: backup image does not exist: " + imageDir);
761          isValid = false;
762          break;
763        }
764        LOG.info("Backup image: " + image.getBackupId() + " for '" + table + "' is available");
765      }
766    }
767    return isValid;
768  }

816  public static BulkLoadHFiles createLoader(Configuration config) {
817    // set configuration for restore:
818    // LoadIncrementalHFile needs more time
819    // <name>hbase.rpc.timeout</name> <value>600000</value>
820    // calculates
821    Configuration conf = new Configuration(config);
822    conf.setInt(HConstants.HBASE_RPC_TIMEOUT_KEY, MILLISEC_IN_HOUR);
823
824    // By default, it is 32 and loader will fail if # of files in any region exceed this
825    // limit. Bad for snapshot restore.
826    conf.setInt(BulkLoadHFiles.MAX_FILES_PER_REGION_PER_FAMILY, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
827    conf.set(BulkLoadHFiles.IGNORE_UNMATCHED_CF_CONF_KEY, "yes");
828    return BulkLoadHFiles.create(conf);
829  }

831  public static String findMostRecentBackupId(String[] backupIds) {
832    long recentTimestamp = Long.MIN_VALUE;
833    for (String backupId : backupIds) {
834      long ts = Long.parseLong(Iterators.get(Splitter.on('_').split(backupId).iterator(), 1));
835      if (ts > recentTimestamp) {
836        recentTimestamp = ts;
837      }
838    }
839    return BackupRestoreConstants.BACKUPID_PREFIX + recentTimestamp;
840  }

842  /**
843   * roll WAL writer for all region servers and record the newest log roll result
844   */
845  public static void logRoll(Connection conn, String backupRootDir, Configuration conf)
846    throws IOException {
847    boolean legacy = conf.getBoolean("hbase.backup.logroll.legacy.used", false);
848    if (legacy) {
849      logRollV1(conn, backupRootDir);
850    } else {
851      logRollV2(conn, backupRootDir);
852    }
853  }
854
855  private static void logRollV1(Connection conn, String backupRootDir) throws IOException {
856    try (Admin admin = conn.getAdmin()) {
857      admin.execProcedure(LogRollMasterProcedureManager.ROLLLOG_PROCEDURE_SIGNATURE,
858        LogRollMasterProcedureManager.ROLLLOG_PROCEDURE_NAME,
859        ImmutableMap.of("backupRoot", backupRootDir));
860    }
861  }
862
863  private static void logRollV2(Connection conn, String backupRootDir) throws IOException {
864    BackupSystemTable backupSystemTable = new BackupSystemTable(conn);
865    HashMap<String, Long> lastLogRollResult =
866      backupSystemTable.readRegionServerLastLogRollResult(backupRootDir);
867    try (Admin admin = conn.getAdmin()) {
868      Map<ServerName, Long> newLogRollResult = admin.rollAllWALWriters();
869
870      for (Map.Entry<ServerName, Long> entry : newLogRollResult.entrySet()) {
871        ServerName serverName = entry.getKey();
872        long newHighestWALFilenum = entry.getValue();
873
874        String address = toHostKey(serverName.getAddress().toString());
875        Long lastHighestWALFilenum = lastLogRollResult.get(address);
876        if (lastHighestWALFilenum != null && lastHighestWALFilenum > newHighestWALFilenum) {
877          LOG.warn("Won't update last roll log result for server {}: current = {}, new = {}",
878            serverName, lastHighestWALFilenum, newHighestWALFilenum);
879        } else {
880          backupSystemTable.writeRegionServerLastLogRollResult(address, newHighestWALFilenum,
881            backupRootDir);
882          if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
883            LOG.debug("updated last roll log result for {} from {} to {}", serverName,
884              lastHighestWALFilenum, newHighestWALFilenum);
885          }
886        }
887      }
888    }
889  }

891  /**
892   * Calculates the replication checkpoint timestamp used for continuous backup.
893   * <p>
894   * A replication checkpoint is the earliest timestamp across all region servers such that every
895   * WAL entry before that point is known to be replicated to the target system. This is essential
896   * for features like Point-in-Time Restore (PITR) and incremental backups, where we want to
897   * confidently restore data to a consistent state without missing updates.
898   * <p>
899   * The checkpoint is calculated using a combination of:
900   * <ul>
901   * <li>The start timestamps of WAL files currently being replicated for each server.</li>
902   * <li>The latest successfully replicated timestamp recorded by the replication marker chore.</li>
903   * </ul>
904   * <p>
905   * We combine these two sources to handle the following challenges:
906   * <ul>
907   * <li><b>Stale WAL start times:</b> If replication traffic is low or WALs are long-lived, the
908   * replication offset may point to the same WAL for a long time, resulting in stale timestamps
909   * that underestimate progress. This could delay PITR unnecessarily.</li>
910   * <li><b>Limitations of marker-only tracking:</b> The replication marker chore stores the last
911   * successfully replicated timestamp per region server in a system table. However, this data may
912   * become stale if the server goes offline or region ownership changes. For example, if a region
913   * initially belonged to rs1 and was later moved to rs4 due to re-balancing, rs1’s marker would
914   * persist even though it no longer holds any regions. Relying solely on these stale markers could
915   * lead to incorrect or outdated checkpoints.</li>
916   * </ul>
917   * <p>
918   * To handle these limitations, the method:
919   * <ol>
920   * <li>Verifies that the continuous backup peer exists to ensure replication is enabled.</li>
921   * <li>Retrieves WAL replication queue information for the peer, collecting WAL start times per
922   * region server. This gives us a lower bound for replication progress.</li>
923   * <li>Reads the marker chore's replicated timestamps from the backup system table.</li>
924   * <li>For servers found in both sources, if the marker timestamp is more recent than the WAL's
925   * start timestamp, we use the marker (since replication has progressed beyond the WAL).</li>
926   * <li>We discard marker entries for region servers that are not present in WAL queues, assuming
927   * those servers are no longer relevant (e.g., decommissioned or reassigned).</li>
928   * <li>The checkpoint is the minimum of all chosen timestamps — i.e., the slowest replicating
929   * region server.</li>
930   * <li>Finally, we persist the updated marker information to include any newly participating
931   * region servers.</li>
932   * </ol>
933   * <p>
934   * Note: If the replication marker chore is disabled, we fall back to using only the WAL start
935   * times. This ensures correctness but may lead to conservative checkpoint estimates during idle
936   * periods.
937   * @param conn the HBase connection
938   * @return the calculated replication checkpoint timestamp
939   * @throws IOException if reading replication queues or updating the backup system table fails
940   */
941  public static long getReplicationCheckpoint(Connection conn) throws IOException {
942    Configuration conf = conn.getConfiguration();
943    long checkpoint = EnvironmentEdgeManager.getDelegate().currentTime();
944
945    // Step 1: Ensure the continuous backup replication peer exists
946    if (!continuousBackupReplicationPeerExists(conn.getAdmin())) {
947      String msg = "Replication peer '" + CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_REPLICATION_PEER
948        + "' not found. Continuous backup not enabled.";
949      LOG.error(msg);
950      throw new IOException(msg);
951    }
952
953    // Step 2: Get all replication queues for the continuous backup peer
954    ReplicationQueueStorage queueStorage =
955      ReplicationStorageFactory.getReplicationQueueStorage(conn, conf);
956
957    List<ReplicationQueueId> queueIds;
958    try {
959      queueIds = queueStorage.listAllQueueIds(CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_REPLICATION_PEER);
960    } catch (ReplicationException e) {
961      String msg = "Failed to retrieve replication queue IDs for peer '"
962        + CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_REPLICATION_PEER + "'";
963      LOG.error(msg, e);
964      throw new IOException(msg, e);
965    }
966
967    if (queueIds.isEmpty()) {
968      String msg = "Replication peer '" + CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_REPLICATION_PEER + "' has no queues. "
969        + "This may indicate that continuous backup replication is not initialized correctly.";
970      LOG.error(msg);
971      throw new IOException(msg);
972    }
973
974    // Step 3: Build a map of ServerName -> WAL start timestamp (lowest seen per server)
975    Map<ServerName, Long> serverToCheckpoint = new HashMap<>();
976    for (ReplicationQueueId queueId : queueIds) {
977      Map<String, ReplicationGroupOffset> offsets;
978      try {
979        offsets = queueStorage.getOffsets(queueId);
980      } catch (ReplicationException e) {
981        String msg = "Failed to fetch WAL offsets for replication queue: " + queueId;
982        LOG.error(msg, e);
983        throw new IOException(msg, e);
984      }
985
986      for (ReplicationGroupOffset offset : offsets.values()) {
987        String walFile = offset.getWal();
988        long ts = AbstractFSWALProvider.getTimestamp(walFile); // WAL creation time
989        ServerName server = queueId.getServerName();
990        // Store the minimum timestamp per server (ts - 1 to avoid edge boundary issues)
991        serverToCheckpoint.merge(server, ts - 1, Math::min);
992      }
993    }
994
995    // Step 4: If replication markers are enabled, overlay fresher timestamps from backup system
996    // table
997    boolean replicationMarkerEnabled =
998      conf.getBoolean(REPLICATION_MARKER_ENABLED_KEY, REPLICATION_MARKER_ENABLED_DEFAULT);
999    if (replicationMarkerEnabled) {
1000      try (BackupSystemTable backupSystemTable = new BackupSystemTable(conn)) {
1001        Map<ServerName, Long> markerTimestamps = backupSystemTable.getBackupCheckpointTimestamps();
1002
1003        for (Map.Entry<ServerName, Long> entry : markerTimestamps.entrySet()) {
1004          ServerName server = entry.getKey();
1005          long markerTs = entry.getValue();
1006
1007          // If marker timestamp is newer, override
1008          if (serverToCheckpoint.containsKey(server)) {
1009            long current = serverToCheckpoint.get(server);
1010            if (markerTs > current) {
1011              serverToCheckpoint.put(server, markerTs);
1012            }
1013          } else {
1014            // This server is no longer active (e.g., RS moved or removed); skip
1015            if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
1016              LOG.debug("Skipping replication marker timestamp for inactive server: {}", server);
1017            }
1018          }
1019        }
1020
1021        // Step 5: Persist current server timestamps into backup system table
1022        for (Map.Entry<ServerName, Long> entry : serverToCheckpoint.entrySet()) {
1023          backupSystemTable.updateBackupCheckpointTimestamp(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
1024        }
1025      }
1026    } else {
1027      LOG.warn(
1028        "Replication marker chore is disabled. Using WAL-based timestamps only for checkpoint calculation.");
1029    }
1030
1031    // Step 6: Calculate final checkpoint as minimum timestamp across all active servers
1032    for (long ts : serverToCheckpoint.values()) {
1033      checkpoint = Math.min(checkpoint, ts);
1034    }
1035
1036    return checkpoint;
1037  }
1038
1039  private static boolean continuousBackupReplicationPeerExists(Admin admin) throws IOException {
1040    return admin.listReplicationPeers().stream()
1041      .anyMatch(peer -> peer.getPeerId().equals(CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_REPLICATION_PEER));
1042  }

1053  /**
1054   * Fetches bulkload filepaths based on the given time range from backup WAL directory.
1055   */
1056  public static List<Path> collectBulkFiles(Connection conn, TableName sourceTable,
1057    TableName targetTable, long startTime, long endTime, Path restoreRootDir, List<String> walDirs)
1058    throws IOException {
1059
1060    if (walDirs.isEmpty()) {
1061      String walBackupDir = conn.getConfiguration().get(CONF_CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_WAL_DIR);
1062      if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(walBackupDir)) {
1063        throw new IOException(
1064          "WAL backup directory is not configured " + CONF_CONTINUOUS_BACKUP_WAL_DIR);
1065      }
1066      Path walDirPath = new Path(walBackupDir);
1067      walDirs =
1068        BackupUtils.getValidWalDirs(conn.getConfiguration(), walDirPath, startTime, endTime);
1069    }
1070
1071    if (walDirs.isEmpty()) {
1072      LOG.warn("No valid WAL directories found for range {} - {}. Skipping bulk-file collection.",
1073        startTime, endTime);
1074      return Collections.emptyList();
1075    }
1076
1077    LOG.info(
1078      "Starting WAL bulk-file collection for source: {}, target: {}, time range: {} - {}, WAL "
1079        + "backup dir: {}, restore root: {}",
1080      sourceTable, targetTable, startTime, endTime, walDirs, restoreRootDir);
1081    String walDirsCsv = String.join(",", walDirs);
1082
1083    return BulkFilesCollector.collectFromWalDirs(HBaseConfiguration.create(conn.getConfiguration()),
1084      walDirsCsv, restoreRootDir, sourceTable, targetTable, startTime, endTime);
1085  }
1086
1087  /**
1088   * Fetches valid WAL directories based on the given time range.
1089   */
1090  public static List<String> getValidWalDirs(Configuration conf, Path walBackupDir, long startTime,
1091    long endTime) throws IOException {
1092    FileSystem backupFs = FileSystem.get(walBackupDir.toUri(), conf);
1093    FileStatus[] dayDirs = backupFs.listStatus(new Path(walBackupDir, WALS_DIR));
1094
1095    List<String> validDirs = new ArrayList<>();
1096    SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat(DATE_FORMAT);
1097    dateFormat.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone(ZoneOffset.UTC));
1098
1099    for (FileStatus dayDir : dayDirs) {
1100      if (!dayDir.isDirectory()) {
1101        continue; // Skip files, only process directories
1102      }
1103
1104      String dirName = dayDir.getPath().getName();
1105      try {
1106        Date dirDate = dateFormat.parse(dirName);
1107        long dirStartTime = dirDate.getTime(); // Start of that day (00:00:00)
1108        long dirEndTime = dirStartTime + ONE_DAY_IN_MILLISECONDS - 1; // End time of day (23:59:59)
1109
1110        // Check if this day's WAL files overlap with the required time range
1111        if (dirEndTime >= startTime && dirStartTime <= endTime) {
1112          validDirs.add(dayDir.getPath().toString());
1113        }
1114      } catch (ParseException e) {
1115        LOG.warn("Skipping invalid directory name: {}", dirName, e);
1116      }
1117    }
1118    return validDirs;
1119  }
